title: FavStash Original Short-Form SFX Starter Pack
guidance: Use effects as narrative punctuation. Keep them below intelligible speech and avoid adding one merely to satisfy a cadence rule.

sounds.title: Soft Click
sounds.recommendedUse: Small text changes, ticks, or quiet interface moments.
sounds.provenance: Deterministically synthesized by scripts/generate-sfx.mjs; contains no third-party recording.

sounds.title: Hard Click
sounds.recommendedUse: Decisive UI selection or a sharp visual cut.
sounds.provenance: Deterministically synthesized by scripts/generate-sfx.mjs; contains no third-party recording.

sounds.title: Clean Pop
sounds.recommendedUse: Word, icon, or lightweight graphic reveals.
sounds.provenance: Deterministically synthesized by scripts/generate-sfx.mjs; contains no third-party recording.

sounds.title: Clean Ding
sounds.recommendedUse: A positive result or satisfying completion; use sparingly.
sounds.provenance: Deterministically synthesized by scripts/generate-sfx.mjs; contains no third-party recording.

sounds.title: Error Buzz
sounds.recommendedUse: A clear mistake or contrast beat; avoid under serious narration.
sounds.provenance: Deterministically synthesized by scripts/generate-sfx.mjs; contains no third-party recording.

sounds.title: Soft Whoosh
sounds.recommendedUse: Slow pans, card movement, or a soft scene transition.
sounds.provenance: Deterministically synthesized by scripts/generate-sfx.mjs; contains no third-party recording.

sounds.title: Fast Whoosh
sounds.recommendedUse: A motivated whip, swipe, or rapid reframing transition.
sounds.provenance: Deterministically synthesized by scripts/generate-sfx.mjs; contains no third-party recording.

sounds.title: Deep Whoosh
sounds.recommendedUse: A major section change or slower high-stakes reveal.
sounds.provenance: Deterministically synthesized by scripts/generate-sfx.mjs; contains no third-party recording.

sounds.title: Short Riser
sounds.recommendedUse: Build toward a reveal; resolve it rather than leaving tension hanging.
sounds.provenance: Deterministically synthesized by scripts/generate-sfx.mjs; contains no third-party recording.

sounds.title: Sub Impact
sounds.recommendedUse: One important claim, number, or final reveal—not every cut.
sounds.provenance: Deterministically synthesized by scripts/generate-sfx.mjs; contains no third-party recording.

sounds.title: Typing Tick
sounds.recommendedUse: Occasional typed-character accents; never repeat on every letter for long copy.
sounds.provenance: Deterministically synthesized by scripts/generate-sfx.mjs; contains no third-party recording.

sounds.title: Sparkle
sounds.recommendedUse: A delightful payoff or premium highlight; keep below the voice.
sounds.provenance: Deterministically synthesized by scripts/generate-sfx.mjs; contains no third-party recording.
